scenarios.prompt: Build a table-tennis game with realistic topspin, backspin, sidespin and chop where one-hand pointer gestures choose the stroke and the face angle is solved toward a target.

criteria.physics: One impulse contact model (restitution + friction capped at rolling) and drag/Magnus flight serve player, opponent, prediction and solver; outcomes are not scripted.
criteria.assists: Assists are declared per difficulty and only change what is read or reached (spin-read fraction, reach, auto height/footwork, serve placement); own brush is always known and coefficients never change.
criteria.evidence: Unit, calibration-matrix, self-play and debug-assisted bot evidence are reported separately; human feel stays not-run until a person plays.
